Written and re-checked every citation against the pinned tree.

- **Output:** `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener-ds-rescreen/14793.json`
- **Trust decision:** the `packages/argv-parser` unsafe-operations denylist, applied at `simple-git/src/lib/plugins/block-unsafe-operations-plugin.ts:13`, is what decides; at the pinned commit it has no row for `trailer.<token>.cmd/.command` writes and no rebase `-x/--exec` rule, so attacker-named commands pass to git.
- **pattern_fit:** `A+B` (three fix sites in two layers of one published diff, plus a rename-section route into the same sink the fix never touched).
- **Strongest lever:** the tokeniser option table (`flag-specs.ts:43-91`) — rebase clusters like `-qx` stay one opaque token unless every rebase short switch is declared, so a flag-matcher-only fix silently misses them; the `trailer.cmd` vs `trailer.<token>.command` pair is the second.
- **Biggest red flag:** none of the O12 definitions holds; the nearest risks are medium recall (published GHSA + CVE) and unverifiable repo size.
